name: PCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top prize, contested through four holders and a vacancy in 1997 before the promotion closed with no further title update on record.

name: PCW Columbia Valley Championship
epitaph: A regional secondary title the promotion's own broadcasters called the toughest belt to hold in PCW.

name: PCW Television Championship
epitaph: The promotion's television title, defended on its weekly broadcasts and its pay-per-view cards alike.

name: PCW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The promotion's tag championship, briefly unified with DPW's own belts before that promotion closed.
